metadata.name: Offshore Wind Farm SES
metadata.description: Coastal social-ecological system around an offshore wind installation: energy demand drives construction, with downstream ecological + socioeconomic effects.
metadata.focal_issue: Spatial conflict between offshore renewable-energy development and marine biodiversity in EU coastal waters.
metadata.definition_statement: An analysis of how offshore wind farm siting decisions interact with seabird, cetacean, and benthic ecosystem services in the Macaronesia demonstration area.
metadata.system_in_focus: Offshore wind farms and adjacent marine ecosystems.

elements.label: Climate-policy targets
elements.description: EU 2030/2050 emission-reduction commitments driving renewable rollout.

elements.label: Energy security demand
elements.description: Geopolitical pressure for domestic generation capacity.

elements.label: Wind farm construction
elements.description: Pile driving, cable laying, vessel traffic during build phase.

elements.label: Wind farm operation
elements.description: Steady-state generation, periodic maintenance vessel visits.

elements.label: Commercial fishing nearby
elements.description: Trawling and net-fishing in adjacent waters.

elements.label: Habitat disturbance
elements.description: Seabed scour around foundations and cable trenches.

elements.label: Bird collision risk
elements.description: Migratory and seabird routes intersecting rotor areas.

elements.label: Benthic communities
elements.description: Seabed-dwelling species, including those forming reefs on foundations.

elements.label: Pelagic fish stocks
elements.description: Mid-water fish populations using the area as foraging ground.

elements.label: Marine mammal populations
elements.description: Cetaceans sensitive to noise and shipping traffic.

elements.label: Avoided emissions value
